headline: On November 26, 2018: Insight lands on Mars
captionCards: InSight landed autonomously using a pre-programmed operation list
It advanced our understanding of Mars' internal structure through seismic data
instagramCaption:
InSight touches down on Elysium Planitia.

The robotic probe InSight successfully landed on Mars on November 26, 2018. It was an uncrewed spacecraft designed for scientific measurements. The lander executed a pre-programmed sequence of operations without real-time human input. Its mission included studying the planet's interior structure.

It remains a key milestone in planetary science and autonomous space exploration.
